subject: general
question:
**The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.**

The road was blocked / so we had / to turn back and / find another one route.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'find another one route'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here,** 'find another route'** should be used instead of **'find another one route'.**
 
• When we use the **indefinite** article '**an**' before **other**, we write it as one word: **another**.
 
• The word '**another**' means 'one more person or thing of the same kind'. (अन्‍यतर, उसी प्रकार का दूसरा, एक और)
 
 
• *Example: Would you like **another** drink?*
 
 
 
• Whereas,** 'another one' **in the given context is incorrect. Here, '**one**' should be removed.

 

**Correct Sentence:__** *The road was blocked so we had to turn back and** find another route.***** **
